name: crt.sh
description: Sectigo-operated Certificate Transparency log search engine for passive subdomain and TLS certificate discovery.
ethicalNote: 100% passive: queries public CT logs without sending packets to the target domain.

name: Wayback Machine (Internet Archive)
description: Historical web archive storing hundreds of billions of captured web pages and CDX timeline snapshots.
ethicalNote: Passive reading of archived snapshots; Note that requesting a brand-new 'Save Page Now' fetches the live site.

name: ICANN Lookup (RDAP)
description: Official ICANN Registration Data Access Protocol (RDAP) client for querying authoritative domain registration records.
ethicalNote: Completely passive registry lookup; respect GDPR/redacted registrant privacy.

name: Shodan
description: Search engine for internet-connected device banners, TLS certificates, ports, and ASN exposure pre-indexed by Shodan sensors.
ethicalNote: Passive ONLY if searching Shodan's index; never connect to or test credentials on discovered devices.

name: Censys Search
description: Internet-wide host and X.509 certificate dataset for passive infrastructure and TLS pivoting.
ethicalNote: Passive query against Censys datasets; do not actively probe returned hosts without written authorization.

name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
description: Autonomous System Number (ASN), IPv4/IPv6 prefix announcement, peering, and IRR routing explorer.
ethicalNote: Passive global routing table inspection.

name: DNSDumpster
description: Domain research utility mapping DNS records (A, MX, TXT, NS) and visual host topology from public sources.
ethicalNote: Passive aggregator; verify findings against authoritative DNS.

name: SecurityTrails
description: Historical passive DNS, A/MX/NS record changes, and subdomain inventory platform.
ethicalNote: Passive historical DNS database lookup.

name: ViewDNS.info
description: Suite of passive IP history, reverse NS, reverse MX, and ASN lookup utilities.
ethicalNote: Use passive history/registry lookups; avoid port-scanner widgets on unauthorized targets.

name: ARIN Whois/RDAP
description: North American Regional Internet Registry database for IP netblocks, ASNs, and organization handles.
ethicalNote: Public RIR registry query; abide by ARIN acceptable use policies against bulk spam harvesting.

name: RIPEstat
description: RIPE NCC open data platform for BGP routing history, IP geolocation allocation, and ASN neighbors across Europe/MENA.
ethicalNote: Open RIR telemetry; passive research safe.

name: APNIC Whois
description: Asia-Pacific Network Information Centre IP and ASN allocation lookup portal.
ethicalNote: Passive RIR query for Asia-Pacific netblock ownership.

name: Google Advanced Search
description: Structured interface for building precision site:, filetype:, intitle:, and date-bounded search queries.
ethicalNote: Searching indexed pages is passive, but clicking discovered sensitive links touches the target server.

name: DuckDuckGo Search Syntax
description: Privacy-respecting search engine supporting site:, filetype:, and region-neutral query comparison.
ethicalNote: Useful for reducing personalized filter-bubble bias during research.

name: Bing Visual & Web Search
description: Microsoft search index supporting ip:, site:, contains:, and object-crop visual search.
ethicalNote: Passive query against Microsoft's web index.

name: Yandex Images
description: High-performing reverse image and landmark recognition engine for architectural and terrain matching.
ethicalNote: Do not upload confidential or sensitive personal photos to third-party search engines.

name: TinEye
description: Exact and altered image fingerprint search engine capable of sorting results by 'Oldest' to find earliest publication.
ethicalNote: Ideal for debunking recycled crisis photos by sorting by earliest crawl date.

name: ExifTool
description: Phil Harvey's gold-standard command-line utility for reading, writing, and auditing EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and PDF metadata locally.
ethicalNote: Runs 100% locally offline—safest way to inspect file metadata without uploading files externally.

name: InVID / WeVerify Verification Plugin
description: Journalism verification toolkit extracting video keyframes, magnifier loupe views, and multi-engine reverse image lookups.
ethicalNote: Built for newsroom fact-checking and human-rights verification.

name: FotoForensics
description: Educational Error Level Analysis (ELA) and metadata inspection platform for JPEG recompression study.
ethicalNote: Uploaded images become accessible on public/shared analysis servers; never upload private material.

name: Content Credentials Verify (C2PA)
description: Official Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity inspector for cryptographic camera/AI provenance manifests.
ethicalNote: Note that absence of C2PA metadata does not prove manipulation; presence proves signed chain of edits.

name: SunCalc
description: Solar azimuth, altitude, shadow length, and twilight phase calculator for any coordinate and date/time.
ethicalNote: Essential passive chronolocation math tool.

name: OpenStreetMap
description: Crowdsourced global vector map database containing detailed infrastructure, footpaths, power lines, and building tags.
ethicalNote: Open ODbL data; passive geospatial reference.

name: Overpass Turbo
description: Web-based data mining query interface for OpenStreetMap—find e.g. 'every hospital within 100m of a railway line and water tower'.
ethicalNote: Purely queries public OSM geometry; avoid overly broad unindexed queries to respect public servers.

name: Google Earth Web
description: 3D terrain elevation and historical satellite imagery viewer for horizon matching and structural change analysis.
ethicalNote: Always check satellite capture dates in Google Earth Pro before drawing timeline conclusions.

name: Copernicus Browser (Sentinel Hub)
description: European Space Agency Sentinel-1 (radar) and Sentinel-2 (optical) frequent revisit satellite imagery portal.
ethicalNote: Open public Earth observation data used for environmental, disaster, and conflict verification.

name: WhatsMyName Web
description: Community-maintained username enumeration matrix checking public profile existence across hundreds of platforms.
ethicalNote: Same handle != same person; always corroborate with secondary bio/link evidence before attributing.

name: Sherlock Project
description: Command-line open-source tool for locating public social media accounts by username across social networks.
ethicalNote: Use strictly within legal scope and rate limits; verify false positives manually.

name: Maigret
description: Public profile username checker that parses public page tags and generates HTML/PDF link reports.
ethicalNote: Use only on authorized research subjects; never scrape behind login walls.

name: Have I Been Pwned (HIBP)
description: Troy Hunt's breach metadata notification service revealing which historical breaches included an email or domain.
ethicalNote: Exposes ONLY breach metadata (never plaintext passwords). Never download or trade raw leaked credential dumps.

name: MXToolbox
description: Email header analyzer and DNS MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC policy diagnostic suite.
ethicalNote: Header parsing is 100% local/passive; great for phishing header trace labs.

name: CyberChef
description: Browser-side data transformation 'Swiss Army Knife' for Base64, hex magic bytes, URL defanging, hashes, and timestamps.
ethicalNote: Executes inside browser memory with zero server uploads; downloadable for offline air-gapped use.

name: archive.today (archive.ph)
description: Web page snapshot search and preservation service capturing rendered DOM text and visual layout.
ethicalNote: Searching existing snapshots is passive; triggering a new capture sends archive servers to the URL.

name: BuiltWith
description: Pre-indexed web technology profiler tracking CMS, analytics IDs, CDN providers, and historical stack changes.
ethicalNote: Passive query of BuiltWith's crawl database for technology correlation.

name: MITRE ATT&CK Navigator
description: Interactive matrix tool for annotating, coloring, and exporting adversary Reconnaissance (TA0043) and post-compromise TTP layers.
ethicalNote: Standard defensive CTI mapping framework.

name: MITRE ATT&CK Knowledge Base
description: Authoritative encyclopedia of adversary tactics, techniques, threat groups, software, and mitigations.
ethicalNote: Public defensive knowledge base.

name: urlscan.io
description: Website sandbox and search index recording DOM, HTTP transactions, TLS certs, IP ASN, screenshots, and page hashes.
ethicalNote: Searching existing scans is 100% passive; submitting a new public scan fetches the URL and publishes it publicly (avoid leaking private internal URLs!).

name: VirusTotal
description: Multi-engine hash, domain, IP, and passive DNS relationship graph for malware and phishing triage.
ethicalNote: Query by SHA-256 hash first! Never upload sensitive internal documents, as uploaded files are shared with VT enterprise subscribers.

name: AlienVault OTX (LevelBlue)
description: Open Threat Exchange community platform sharing threat pulses, passive DNS, and STIX/CSV IOC feeds.
ethicalNote: Always validate community IOCs for false positives (e.g., shared Cloudflare/AWS IPs) before blocking.

name: abuse.ch URLhaus & ThreatFox
description: Swiss non-profit CTI projects tracking active malware distribution URLs (URLhaus), C2 IOCs (ThreatFox), and MalwareBazaar hashes.
ethicalNote: Defang all live malware URLs (`hxxps://`) in notes; never click live payload links outside an isolated malware lab.

name: Pulsedive
description: Threat intelligence search and IOC enrichment platform scoring risk factors across IPs, domains, and threat feeds.
ethicalNote: Use passive lookup mode during SOC triage.

name: GreyNoise Visualizer
description: Global honeypot sensor network distinguishing harmless internet background scanners ('RIOT' / benign bots) from mass exploitation.
ethicalNote: Essential SOC L1 tool for cutting noisy internet-wide scanner alert fatigue.

name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)
description: Authoritative catalog of CVEs confirmed to be actively exploited in the wild, driving evidence-based patching.
ethicalNote: Public defensive prioritization standard.

name: FIRST EPSS Lookup
description: Exploit Prediction Scoring System estimating the 30-day probability of a CVE being exploited in the wild.
ethicalNote: Combine EPSS + CISA KEV + passive asset exposure for smart vulnerability triage.

name: MISP Threat Sharing
description: Open-source threat intelligence and IOC sharing platform supporting TLP taxonomies, Admiralty galaxies, and STIX export.
ethicalNote: Enforce TLP markings strictly before federating events.

name: OpenCTI
description: STIX 2.1 native knowledge graph platform linking Threat Actors, Campaigns, Infrastructure, Malware, and Reports.
ethicalNote: Self-hostable structured CTI repository.

name: OpenCorporates
description: World's largest open database of legal company registrations, directors, incorporation dates, and filings across 140+ jurisdictions.
ethicalNote: Always cross-verify aggregated summaries against the primary national company registry.

name: SEC EDGAR Search
description: Official U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission corporate disclosures (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K cybersecurity incident filings, subsidiaries).
ethicalNote: Authoritative primary-source public regulatory filings.

name: GLEIF LEI Search
description: Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation directory mapping 'Level 1' identity and 'Level 2' direct/ultimate parent company trees.
ethicalNote: Open global financial transparency dataset.

name: UK Companies House
description: Official UK corporate registry providing incorporation filings, accounts, officers, and Persons with Significant Control (PSC).
ethicalNote: Public statutory records; use accurately within legal due diligence scope.

name: OpenSanctions
description: Consolidated international sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), and regulatory enforcement lists (OFAC, UN, EU, UK).
ethicalNote: Name match != identity match; corroborate DOB, nationality, and passport/LEI identifiers.

name: SpiderFoot (Open Source)
description: Automated OSINT collection and entity correlation tool with configurable passive-only scan profiles.
ethicalNote: In passive engagements, strictly select the 'Passive' use-case profile so zero requests touch target infrastructure.

name: Maltego CE
description: Visual link-analysis and graph investigation workspace connecting domains, MX records, ASNs, and corporate entities.
ethicalNote: Know what each Transform does before running it—some query passive APIs while others resolve live DNS.

name: Obsidian
description: Local-first Markdown note-taking and bidirectional graph view ideal for maintaining air-gapped investigation logs and citations.
ethicalNote: Stores plain Markdown files locally on your disk with no forced cloud sync.

name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
description: Curated open-source investigative methodology handbook maintained by Bellingcat researchers covering satellite, transport, and archiving tools.
ethicalNote: Follow Bellingcat's ethical standards on graphic trauma hygiene and open corroboration.
